description: Angular component for editing mobile actions in a widget configuration, including form handling, dynamic control creation, and action configuration logic.

classes.name: MobileActionEditorComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing ControlValueAccessor for editing mobile widget actions with dynamic form controls and configuration logic.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback function to propagate changes.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Registers a callback for touch events (not implemented).

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes form groups, subscribes to form value changes, and sets up default action configurations.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls based on input.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Patches form values from external model and updates internal state.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Constructs the descriptor object from form values and propagates change.

methods.name: updateMobileActionType
methods.description: Updates form controls and default functions based on selected mobile action type.

methods.name: getActionConfigs

methods.description: Sets up common action configuration controls.
